title: Fused silica microspheres from fulgurites; Drumm inside a boat pit

tellings.quote: fused silica this is me down inside one of the boat pits adjacent to the great pyramid

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, who has his own theory of what the pyramids were really for, says he found fused silica, tiny glassy beads of the kind found in fulgurites, the glass tubes lightning leaves when it strikes sand, at Giza in Egypt. He shows Michels a picture of himself standing in one of the boat pits, the long pits cut into the rock beside the Great Pyramid: "this is me down inside one of the boat pits adjacent to the great pyramid." He tells it as something he saw himself, and it matters to him because such glass would point to intense heat or electricity at the site.
